mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adoption_record (pet_id, adopter_id, adoption_date) VALUES (#{pet.id}, #{adopter.id}, #{adoptionDate})
mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.adoption_date, p.id as pet_id, p.name as pet_name, p.species as pet_species, p.age as pet_age, p.adopt_status as pet_adopt_status, a.id as adopter_id, a.name as adopter_name, a.phone as adopter_phone, a.address as adopter_address FROM adoption_record ar JOIN pet p ON ar.pet_id = p.id JOIN adopter a ON ar.adopter_id = a.id ORDER BY ar.adoption_date DESC

SELECT ar.id, ar.adoption_date, p.id as pet_id, p.name as pet_name, p.species as pet_species, p.age as pet_age, p.adopt_status as pet_adopt_status, a.id as adopter_id, a.name as adopter_name, a.phone as adopter_phone, a.address as adopter_address FROM adoption_record ar JOIN pet p ON ar.pet_id = p.id JOIN adopter a ON ar.adopter_id = a.id WHERE ar.pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY ar.adoption_date DESC
